info.title: Dashboard API
info.description:
REST API for Data Management Dashboard with MongoDB and Express.

Authentication and Tenant Scoping
- Authentication endpoints (e.g., /auth/*, /api/auth/*, /login, /logout, /token, /refresh, /session) are managed externally and are not documented here. Use the Authorize button to provide a Bearer token (JWT).
- Click the "Authorize" button in Swagger UI to enter your Bearer token (JWT) for Authorization.
- For tenant-scoped endpoints, provide the tenant in the x-organization-id header field shown in each request (Swagger UI will show a header input). When a valid JWT is provided, tenant is taken from the token and overrides the header or query values.
- Without JWT (for demo/testing), you may use the x-organization-id header or organization_id/tenant_id query parameter to set scope. The header takes precedence over query.

bearerAuth.description: Provide a valid JWT as a Bearer token. When present, tenant is resolved from the token and overrides x-organization-id and query aliases.

XOrganizationId.name: x-organization-id
XOrganizationId.description: Tenant (organization) identifier header for tenant-scoped endpoints when Authorization is not provided. Alternatively pass as query parameter ?organization_id (or ?tenant_id). Header takes precedence over query aliases. When Authorization (Bearer JWT) is present, the tenant is taken from the token and this header is not required.

OrganizationIdQuery.name: organization_id
OrganizationIdQuery.description: Optional tenant (organization) identifier as a query parameter. Use header x-organization-id instead when possible.

GenericDocument.description: A generic MongoDB document with flexible fields

get.description:
Returns a list of LLM cost documents. Supports optional JSON filter, sorting and pagination. If explicit pagination (page/limit) is provided, response is wrapped with { success, data, meta }. Otherwise a raw array is returned.
Tenant scoping: When Authorization (Bearer JWT) is present, the tenant from the JWT is enforced and overrides any header/query values. If a different organization_id/tenant_id is provided than the JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403. Without JWT (demo/testing), x-organization-id header or query aliases (?tenant_id or ?organization_id) may be used to set scope. Any tenant fields in the filter are ignored server-side.
Debugging: Responses include an X-Applied-Tenant header indicating the resolved tenant filter.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Alias for tenant filter. Ignored when JWT is present. Header takes precedence over query. If conflicting with JWT tenant, 403 is returned.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional page number to enable envelope response

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional page size to enable envelope response

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort string (e.g., -timestamp or total_cost)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON filter (tenant fields ignored by server; scoping enforced)

200.description: Successful response (array or envelope based on pagination params)

403.description: Forbidden: tenant scope mismatch when Authorization is provided

get.description: Returns per-user total cost and total minutes for the specified tenant.

Aggregates distinct active users per tenant primarily from the session_tracking collection. Accepts optional time range and status filters. If includeInactive=true, falls back to the users collection joined with known tenants to include tenants without recent activity.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional ISO date-time lower bound

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional ISO date-time upper bound

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Session status filter. Default "completed|active" (i.e., completed or active).

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: When true, includes tenants from tenants/users collections even if no activity is found.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users with optional JSON filtering and sorting. Tenant scoping: when Authorization is present, the tenant is taken from JWT (req.auth.tenantId) and overrides query/header. If a different organization_id/tenant_id is provided than the JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403. In demo mode without JWT, organization_id from header or query is allowed but is still enforced in filtering.

get.description: Returns time-bucketed counts of distinct active users based on session_tracking. Prefers `last_updated` if present; falls back to `session_start`. Supports optional tenant scope, status filter (pipe-separated), and granularity day|week. Default granularity=day and status=completed|active.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start of range (inclusive). Default is 30 days ago if not provided.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end of range (exclusive for bucketing upper bound). Default is now if not provided.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket size for the time series.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Session status filter. Default "completed|active".

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Optional tenant filter to scope the trend.
